PRIMARY FIX VERIFIED — tutorial navigation flow is now 100% working with REAL user clicks (not force). Regression on /dashboard passes. header-tutorial-btn still fails after modal close, but the root cause is a DIFFERENT pre-existing bug (header layout overlap between export-source-btn and header-tutorial-btn), not the tutorial-fix regression.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard header layout — export-source-btn overlaps header-tutorial-btn
ui_bugs.issue: At 1920x1080 viewport, header-tutorial-btn rect=(x=662, y=24, w=28, h=28) and export-source-btn (ZIP) rect=(x=666, y=22, w=74, h=32) overlap on 24 of 28 pixels wide. elementsFromPoint(676, 38) returns [export-source-btn, DIV, svg, header-tutorial-btn] — ZIP button intercepts pointer events. Playwright real click on header-tutorial-btn fails with 'Timeout exceeded — element not stable/clickable'. Visually in the header the graduation-cap tutorial icon is completely hidden behind the ZIP button. This is a pre-existing header horizontal-overflow bug (many buttons: home, theft, language, tutorial, APK, EXE, ZIP, Accounts, Créa, Public, ViewMode, Notifications, User — cannot fit at desktop widths). iter119 attributed the failure to export-approval-modal; after dismissing the modal queue (6 pending exports), header-tutorial-btn is STILL blocked by export-source-btn. Root cause is layout, not modal.

React hydration warning persists on /dashboard: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' Source: Dashboard.js line 677 render tree — a LanguageToggle button nested inside another button. Non-blocking but noisy.

integration_issues.issue: onClick handler is correct (mouse click at r.x+2, r.y+2 in the 4px gap that's not covered by ZIP did not navigate either — either the click landed on the DIV wrapper or the tiny hit area is unreliable). export-source-btn covers 24/28 px of tutorial button width. Real users cannot click the tutorial icon on desktop. Workarounds: navigate directly to /tutorial URL, or click tutorial-finish from within /tutorial.

issues: Header buttons overlap horizontally: 'APK | EnisEXE | ZIP' zone visibly squished (EN language toggle overlaps EXE button, tutorial icon fully covered by ZIP). Header cannot fit ~13 controls on a single row. Consider: (a) wrapping less-used controls into a kebab menu, (b) reducing button padding, (c) moving tutorial icon to a different location, (d) responsive breakpoints hiding less-critical buttons earlier.

action_items: PRIMARY FIX iter148 IS VERIFIED — no action needed for tutorial page fix.

Options: (a) increase inter-button margin, (b) use a responsive layout that hides secondary buttons at narrow header widths, (c) move header-tutorial-btn to a different section of the header (e.g., far right next to Notifications), (d) collapse export buttons (APK/EXE/ZIP) into a single 'Export ▾' dropdown.

critical_code_review_comments: iter148 FloatingWidgetsGate correctly hides BOTH CalyChatbot AND FeedbackButton on /tutorial (App.js:236-249). Fix is clean and minimal.

Dashboard header (Dashboard.js lines 960-1090) packs too many controls in a single flex row — 13+ buttons — with no responsive collapse logic. Overlap is deterministic at 1920px. Consider mobile-first responsive design or an overflow kebab menu.

export-approval-modal queue (ExportApprovalNotifier) auto-opens ALL pending exports one by one on /dashboard mount for a creator. This is high-friction UX — user must dismiss 6+ modals before touching the dashboard. Consider a single aggregated notification with a badge count.
